checkpoints.description: [1/3] Add inventory shop so the CLI lists station consumables with prices

impact_assessment.why: The cockpit supply locker now shows the four consumables with price, volume, effect and held count, and the REST catalog carries the same data, but the CLI inventory surface only names item IDs in its usage hint; a terminal player cannot see what is for sale or what it costs before buying
impact_assessment.benefits: CLI parity with cockpit and REST for the item shop; the buy command becomes discoverable; no engine change because ITEM_CATALOG already holds the data
impact_assessment.risks: contract: additive inventory subcommand; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first CLI tests for the shop listing and dock note, a real piped CLI run, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Recruit a marine so boarding and capture are reachable headlessly

impact_assessment.why: The captain always recruits crew_roles[0] (pilot) and the recruit route is de-duplicated by path, so a marine is never aboard; the combat policy's board_enemy branch and the ships_captured path therefore never run in campaigns despite being a headline mechanic
impact_assessment.benefits: Marine aboard means boarding and capture become live; the recruit route is keyed by role so a second role can be hired; the crew gap closes with a scripted capture probe as proof
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/crew/recruit de-dup key changes from path to role_id (additive, one more hire); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: one marine per campaign
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first unit tests for the marine purchase and the role signature, a scripted HTTP boarding probe, three-seed campaigns, unchanged gate, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Let the outpost tour climb levels so specialization is reachable

impact_assessment.why: The upgrade route is de-duplicated by path, so one upgrade at level 1 locks every later level; campaigns stop at level 2 and /api/outpost/specialize (level 3) stays in CONTEXT_ACTIONS even though the outpost is founded and the builder exists
impact_assessment.benefits: Outposts reach level 3+ and specialize in 2,000-step campaigns; the upgrade route is keyed by current level so each step is a distinct action; coverage of the outpost tier becomes real
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/outpost/upgrade signature changes from path to level (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: bounded by the five-level cap
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first signature tests, campaign evidence for level and specialization, unchanged gate, full suite and 5/5 gates

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Resolve branching message-tree nodes so the narrative choice surface is reachable

impact_assessment.why: The captain reads inbox messages but never chooses a branch, so all three message trees (precursor signal, refugee flotilla, quantum compact) and /api/messages/choose stay outside the proof surface; a seed-1 campaign ends with two unresolved tree nodes whose choices are live payload, while CONTEXT_ACTIONS still claims the route needs an interactive node the campaign never provides
impact_assessment.benefits: The first unresolved branch is chosen from the live choices payload, follow-up nodes are distinct actions keyed by message_id, permanent outcomes (research, standing, crew, reactor bonuses) reach the campaign, and the 180-step gate exercises the route
impact_assessment.risks: contract: /api/messages/choose leaves CONTEXT_ACTIONS and joins SIGNATURE_ROUTES keyed by message_id (additive); dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: one branch per node, all persist through the existing engine path
impact_assessment.mitigation: failing-first policy tests for choice/read/resolved/signature, a 180-step gate run, 2,000-step campaigns on seeds 1/2/42, full suite and 5/5 gates
